title: Tears of Steel — The Breakup

beats.desc: Celia jabs her robot hand at him: "You're a jerk, Thom."
Thom, all self-justifying: "Look Celia, we have to follow our passions"
Thom gets dreamy: "...I just want to be awesome in space"
Celia fires back: "Why don't you just admit you're freaked out by my robot hand?"
Thom splutters a denial: "I'm not freaked out by— it's..."

title: Tears of Steel — You Broke My Heart

beats.desc: ERROR!!! screens flash red
the scientist screams "No!"
a second, longer "Nooo!"
close-up on Celia: "You broke my heart."
Thom, eyes shut in the robot's grip: "I know."
Celia: "You forgot me on Earth."
Thom again: "I know."
Celia snarls: "I should just crush you!"

title: Night of the Living Dead — They're Coming to Get You

beats.desc: Barbara warns him: "Johnny."
Johnny teases: "You're still afraid."
Barbara: "Stop it now. I mean it."
she turns away; Johnny grins and lets the silence hang
Johnny's spooky voice: "They're coming to get you, Barbara!"
cut to the empty graveyard
Barbara, fed up: "Stop it!"

attribution: Night of the Living Dead (1968, dir. George A. Romero) — public domain | archive.org

title: His Girl Friday — Six Weeks in Reno

beats.desc: Walter, phone in hand, all charm: "How long is it since we've seen each other?"
Hildy, unimpressed: "Oh, well, let's see..."
Hildy counts it off: "Six weeks in Reno, then Bermuda... about four months, I guess."
Hildy: "Seems like yesterday to me."
back to Walter, unbothered: "Maybe it was yesterday, Hildy."

attribution: His Girl Friday (1940, dir. Howard Hawks) — public domain | archive.org
